scope: Corrected replay only; supervisor retrospective source-checkpoint analysis after all participants finished. No participant communication.
method: Use latest recorded source snapshot whose recorded cumulative units are <= each registered budget; also record strict < and over-cap terminal separately.
Retrospective validity transfers only across identical bytes for a module AND all its local source-import dependencies, under the same frozen trusted environment.
Fresh checks are supervisor-owned source-only copies. A file existing, a theorem-shaped declaration, line count, or participant self-report never constitutes verification.
First-identity brackets locate the first recorded occurrence of exact verified source bytes, not the precise moment of proof completion or participant compilation.
Snapshots are live copies; retain recorded copy intervals. There is an unsampled gap between each chosen checkpoint and its budget crossing.
Prefix edits performed by graders are interventions and are not transferred to original earlier checkpoints unless exact original source-closure identity is established.
Mechanical validity is separate from mathematical target acceptance. Only the graders semantic review can award a complete A-E target.
